cues.name: op-done
cues.what: the OP ends: the motto is written, then the seals stamped

cues.name: click-book
cues.what: the book: after, the desk becomes the nav; before, a hard cut

cues.name: take-card
cues.what: after: the pin pops, the card comes to your hand, the dossier slides out; before: a hard cut into the old field notes

cues.name: open-principles
cues.what: the tabs fly to the chapter's fore-edge (#35), the rail is drawn

cues.name: click-shooting
cues.what: shooting: the tab move; the prints develop on their lines

cues.name: open-print
cues.what: unclipped into the viewer with its peg, the rope springs up

cues.name: close-print
cues.what: it flies home and clips back onto the rope

cues.name: pull-card
cues.what: the specimen card pulled out of its sleeve: stick, the lip catches, it pops free

cues.name: flip
cues.what: a tap turns the card over in the hand: its night face, the radar drawn

cues.name: click-home
cues.what: home: the nav falls back into a desk
